meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, one clause Required: the vendor accepts only the Required clause

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen with its default Auction stage.
Apply an auction template before adding line items.
Add the auction line item required for quoting.

args.goal: on the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set the first clause to Required, leave the second clause as None, click Done, and stop when the saved terms are visible on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the stage-wise required and optional terms, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one available QA test vendor for the vendor-portal submission.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Leave the optional clause unaccepted and verify it remains off.
Quote 100 for every line and submit the bid.
Verify that submission succeeded despite the optional clause remaining unaccepted.
